bugs.name: README commit view names a different source branch than PR #5
bugs.summary: The README commit page says “You pushed on branch qa/explore-field-note-20261008,” while PR #5 identifies qa-exploration-docs-20261008 as its source branch.
bugs.expected: Opening the README at PR #5's documentation commit should show its source branch, qa-exploration-docs-20261008.
bugs.actual: The README commit page says “You pushed on branch qa/explore-field-note-20261008,” while PR #5 identifies qa-exploration-docs-20261008 as its source branch.
bugs.reason: Forgejo v16.0.5 intentionally shows recent branches pushed by the signed-in user, with a Compare changes button. This banner also appears on file views and excludes branches with open or merged pull requests; it does not identify the displayed file’s source branch.
